visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing red-framed glasses and a magenta tank top with 'FLOWER' text, stands at a street food stall. She is wearing a black mask. She holds a large piece of pale, raw dough in her left hand and uses a flat metal tool in her right hand to slice thin, leaf-shaped pieces of dough directly into a large stainless steel pot filled with boiling water. The stall behind her is cluttered with boxes and supplies, with a white bag of flour visible. (2) Close-up shots focus on the hands and the dough. The woman's hands move rhythmically, slicing the dough at a steady pace. A metal tray containing coins sits on the counter in the foreground. The pieces of dough are seen floating and boiling in the hot water alongside some green leafy vegetables. (3) A red bowl is filled with flat, wide noodles, topped with a large portion of dark brown diced tofu and vegetables, and garnished with thin strips of green cucumber. Metal chopsticks stir the noodles, lifting them to show their thick, irregular texture and the glossy sauce coating them. (4) The scene shifts to a stainless steel bowl containing clear soup with chopped green onions floating on top. Then, a bowl of beef noodle soup is shown, containing several large chunks of dark brown braised beef and leafy green vegetables in a reddish-brown broth. A white plastic spoon lifts a tender-looking piece of beef and some broth to show the clarity. (5) The camera pans out to show the exterior of the stall. It is a small street-side stand named '山西味 手工刀削麵' (Shanxi Taste Handmade Sliced Noodles) with a yellow sign featuring a cartoon character. A red and yellow canopy covers the stall. Cars are parked on the urban street in the background under clear natural daylight.
